why: The student ignores the asked trace (row {0.1,0.3,0.5}, r=0.95 gives sums 0.1, 0.4, 0.9, never exceeding 0.95, so next stays -1) and instead makes a bare, unjustified remark about the comparison operator; swapping < for <= does give the same result for these values (no cumulative sum equals r), so it is not a wrong rule (L0), but it only names one element with no values traced and no reasoning about what is conserved, and it is not generally true (r equal to a partial sum would differ), so it cannot be L4 — it is L1.
